prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1220; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from insured. Reports minor collision in the parking lot of a shopping center at low speed while reversing. Other vehicle was struck on the rear quarter panel. Insured states she felt neck stiffness shortly after the impact but did not seek care that day. Assigned to field adjuster for vehicle inspection and photo collection.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. She reports ongoing neck pain and headache with some limited rotation to the left. She has scheduled an appointment with her primary care provider and says she will forward records when available. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and states she has no plans to retain one at this time. Explained the claim process and the medical documentation we will need.

Entry 3: Received police-style incident report from the parking lot security office. Report confirms a minor contact between two vehicles with no citations issued. Witness statement obtained from a bystander who saw the vehicles make contact at walking pace. Liability appears to favor the insured's counterparty, pending review of the photos and damage estimates.

Entry 4: Medical records received from the claimant's provider. Diagnosis is whiplash-type cervical strain. Treatment plan includes physical therapy sessions twice weekly for six weeks and a prescription for muscle relaxants. Provider notes a good prognosis with full recovery expected. Records reviewed and entered into the file for bodily injury evaluation.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant to confirm treatment progress. She reports improvement in neck mobility and reduced headache frequency. She confirmed she is attending physical therapy and is comfortable with the current plan. No attorney involved. Bodily injury reserve reviewed and maintained pending final therapy discharge summary. Next contact scheduled after the therapy course is complete.
